prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_care_pledge_screen: Add a new interactive pet care commitment screen right after adoption certificate where users sign a promise to care for their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_care_pledge", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_care_pledge": {"headline": "Make the Pet Care Pledge", "body": "Promise to keep your companion happy, fed, and active on your desktop.", "button_label": "I Promise!", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Caretaker", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] finish_desktop_interaction_demo_screen: Add a dedicated interactive demo screen at the finish step showing how to click, drag, and hide the pet on desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_demo"], "new_desktop_demo": {"headline": "Desktop Companion Controls", "body": "Click your pet to interact, drag to move, or use the tray icon to hide it anytime.", "button_label": "Got It!", "layout": "spotlight"}}
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_tip_timer: Enable visual progress bars, time estimates, and auto-advancing pet tips on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "hint": "We are assembling your pet graphics. This takes under a minute!"}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_story_scroll_redesign: Redesign choose_path into a story_scroll layout with structured comparison cards for instant pet adoption vs custom photo generation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Journey", "body": "Adopt a pre-designed pet right away or generate a custom companion from your photos.", "show_step_counter": true}}
4: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_quality_checklist_hint: Display explicit lighting and angle hints along with an inline quality checklist on photo upload.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results: use clear, bright, front-facing photos with good contrast.", "show_step_counter": true}}
5: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_visibility_copy: Update home_intro text to clearly explain desktop pet placement and system tray controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look for your companion roaming your screen. Right-click or check your system tray to adjust settings."}}
6: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_existing_account_notify: Add an explicit warning and hint for returning users to log in with their original auth method to prevent duplicate accounts.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Returning user? Sign in with your original method to load existing saved pets.", "notify_when_ready": false}}
7: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_grid_layout_redesign: Redesign pick_friend screen using a multi-column grid layout to showcase all starter companions at once.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Pick Your Companion", "body": "Browse available desktop companions and select your favorite."}}
8: [choose_path, new_flow] story_onboarding_intro_flow: Insert a welcoming introductory screen before path selection explaining what a desktop pet is.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_story_welcome", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_story_welcome": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring your desktop to life with an interactive virtual pet that hangs out while you work.", "button_label": "Get Started", "layout": "centered"}}
9: [home, layout] waiting_stage_card_layout: Reformat waiting screen to a stage layout featuring animated pet creation status.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "body": "We are preparing graphics and animations for your desktop companion."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of pet care pledge screen inside onboarding flow.
Valid addition of interactive desktop demo screen after home intro.
Valid update to waiting screen showing progress indicators and pet tips.
Valid redesign of choose_path screen preserving both adoption options.
Valid addition of photo quality guidance hints to upload_photos screen.
Valid copy update to home_intro explaining desktop controls.
Valid sign-in hint added to prevent duplicate accounts.
Valid grid layout redesign for pick_friend screen.
Valid addition of onboarding intro screen before path selection.
Valid stage layout redesign for waiting screen preserving pet creation status.
